feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 4:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe, tracking eastwards. Low pressure west of Ireland.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 at first, though a force or two lower in the southeast of the area. Decreasing south or southeast 4 or 5 in all waters overnight. Becoming northwest 5 to 7 later tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 5 to 7, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight, becoming variable 3 or less later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate occasionally rough, then slight later.


##Weather##

Rain imminently clearing to showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally poor at first.
